content.comment_body: Hello everyone, Does anyone know if a [product_name] module with article number ending in [article_no] is compatible with a [product_name] base module with article number ending in [article_no]? Appreciate any guidance. Thank you.

The last part of the article number, [article_no], isn't enough to determine compatibility. The ending [article_no] appears in multiple product series. For example: - 00-[article_no]: older [product_name] module from the 1990s. - 08-[article_no]: current [product_name] version. Expansion modules with article numbers ending in [article_no] or [article_no] do not work with the newer [product_name] series. Only expansion modules with article numbers ending in [article_no] are compatible with the latest [product_name] modules.
Thanks for the clarification, [user_name]! Your prompt and detailed answer is appreciated.

analysis.insight_summary: There was confusion regarding compatibility between different versions of [product_name] base modules and expansion modules. Unclear article number conventions made it difficult to identify which modules could be paired, leading to uncertainty in configuring hardware. Users found product documentation and compatibility tables challenging to interpret.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect simple, direct guidance on module compatibility—especially information tied to product versions and article numbers. They want quick and definitive advice to avoid mismatched hardware setups.
